summary.name: Learning Python for Data Analysis and Visualization
summary.one_liner: A Udemy video course by Jose Portilla (Pierian Training) teaching Python programming with numpy, pandas, matplotlib, seaborn, and scikit-learn for data analysis and visualization.
use_cases: Learning numpy and pandas for data analysis
Creating data visualizations with seaborn and matplotlib
Building a data science portfolio with example projects
Introduction to machine learning with scikit-learn
summary.what_it_does: The course covers Python programming basics in Jupyter Notebook, then numpy arrays and pandas Series and DataFrames, including indexing, merging, grouping, and reading JSON, HTML, text, and Excel files. It moves on to visualization with seaborn (histograms, KDE, box and violin plots, regression plots, heatmaps). Later sections include guided data projects using Titanic, stock market, and election data, and an introduction to scikit-learn covering regression, classification, SVMs, Naive Bayes, decision trees, and natural language processing. The page lists about 110 lectures totaling roughly 21 hours and says example code notebooks are included.
notable: About 110 lectures and 21 hours of video with over 100 example Python notebooks
Guided data projects using Titanic, stock market, and election datasets
Covers scikit-learn machine learning and NLP topics
Last updated 12/2022; lectures reference Python 2.7 installation
caveats: Installation lecture recommends Python 2.7 and the page is titled 'Ver 1', so content may be dated
Requires an intermediate level of Python; basic to intermediate Python skills are listed as prerequisites
Course is sold on Udemy; the page does not state a price in the text provided
